name: bilance
description: Ask about your own Bilance finances: balances, transactions, budgets, recurring payments and net worth. Optional edits to your records, switchable per app. Never moves money.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about and organize your money
interface.longDescription: Connect your Bilance account to ask about your own money: accounts and balances, transactions with tags and notes, spending summaries and monthly reports, budgets, recurring payments and net worth. When you ask, it can also recategorize and tag transactions, add records, and manage budgets, categories, tags, recurring payments and assets. Changes are on by default and can be switched off per app in Settings > Connected AI apps, where you can also disconnect. Bilance never moves money: it cannot make payments or transfers from your bank. Accounts and transactions a partner shares with you are included.
defaultPrompt: What did I spend on groceries last month?
How am I doing against my budgets?
